sections.heading: Summary
sections.paragraph: IT operations lead moving toward service desk management, with 9 years supporting hybrid workforces. Cut ticket backlog and onboarding time through process changes and automation, and trained the team that runs them.

entries.title: IT Support Lead
bullets: Lead a team of 6 technicians supporting about 900 employees across 4 sites, covering hardware, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID accounts.
Cut open ticket backlog from 410 to 120 in 5 months by adding triage rules and a daily stand-up (with the service desk manager).
Automated new-hire laptop setup with Intune Autopilot, reducing setup time from about 3 hours to 40 minutes per device.

Leveraged a knowledge base rollout to deflect password reset tickets, a long bullet written here on purpose so that the lint step flags it for being far too long for one or two lines on the printed page of a resume.

entries.title: Desktop Support Technician
bullets: Resolved hardware and software tickets for a 300-bed hospital, averaging 25 tickets a day.
Imaged and deployed 450 Windows 10 workstations during the 2019 refresh (one of 3 technicians).
Trained 12 new hires on the ticketing system and escalation paths.

lines.label: Platforms
lines.text: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, Jira Service Management
